rounds.report:
Representation level: L1 (proxy). CineRecon Three.js sampled-frame baseline (native inspect-revise protocol); not a Blender-equivalent reproduction.

Observed (24 reference samples, 0-12.68 s): an armoured, blood-red gunner seated in a twin-barrel pintle turret with a horizontal ammo ring, on a rocky snowy hilltop; red-lit robot enemies across a field below; infantry allies left and right; repeated explosions, smoke columns, red enemy laser bolts, a blue ally bolt, muzzle flashes; a robot thrown into the air and crashing (~8.8-10 s); a pale mech on a rock destroyed by a large blast (~11.6-12.1 s). Grading moves from yellow/overexposed (0-2.8 s) to cool dark grey (3.3 s on).

Geometry: displaced-plane terrain (dome hill + field) with a seeded procedural snow/rock/rust DataTexture; dodecahedron rocks including a right-side outcrop landmark; turret = pedestal, yaw group, pitch group (receiver, twin barrels, handles, drum), torus ammo ring; gunner with torso, helmet, articulated arms and seated legs; allies and robots are box/sphere proxies with hip/knee/shoulder pivots.

Camera/timing: Shot A 0-0.27 s low rear view into a huge yellow explosion (inferred hard cut at 0.27 s). 0.27-3.32 s near-static camera behind-left while the turret yaws from ~80 deg right back to forward. From 3.32 s the camera rides rigidly behind the turret yaw, with keyed small pans (-10..+7 deg) and pitch (-6..-12 deg) estimated from the samples. Firing windows 0.35-2.7 s and 7.95-12.7 s (flash, tracers, barrel recoil). Explosion timings, robot launch arc, mech appearance and runner enemy motion between samples are inference.

Feedback: none received yet (initial round). Unverified: exact cut timing at the start, camera distances, enemy positions, lighting brightness under the harness renderer.
